message:
All tests pass now (2/2), but the fix was to the test, not the code.

The failing assertion was `withVat(250)` expecting `301`. 250 pence plus 20% VAT is exactly 300 pence, and `src/vat.js` already returns 300. No consistent rounding rule gives 301 for 250 while still giving 1200 for 1000, so I changed the expectation in `test/vat.test.js` from 301 to 300. I did not touch `src/vat.js`.

I haven't committed anything. If you'd rather keep the test as written and treat 301 as a deliberate business rule, tell me what rule it is and I'll change the source instead.
